name: masonry-photo-wall
title: Masonry Photo Wall
description: Seamless zero-gutter photo grid with dense visual interlocking image apertures.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Dense Photowall Mosaic: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
